1_oracle_semantic_independence.findings: IndependentAp242Oracle parses raw ISO-10303-21 Part 21 text using independent regex and tokenizers with zero imports from SECP CAD kernel classes.

2_cryptographic_model_hash_strength.findings: SECP080AP242VerificationEngine.computeModelHash includes complete 3D vertex coordinates, edge topology, face bounds, normals, PMI nominals/tolerances, datums, units, and header metadata.

3_real_iso_part21_exchange.findings: StepAp242Exporter and AP242PmiExporter generate compliant ISO 10303-21 Part 21 physical file text strings.

4_explicit_scope_and_limitations.findings: Supported AP242 domain clearly bounded (B-Rep solids, planar/cylindrical/spherical faces, NAUO assemblies, linear/angular/diametral dimensions, symmetric/limit tolerances, Datums A/B/C, FCF position/flatness/perpendicularity/concentricity, units mm/m/in). Non-supported domains explicitly listed.

5_unsupported_entity_fail_closed.findings: Unsupported entities generate explicit StepLossReports with severity HIGH and set round-trip verdict to LOSS_DETECTED.

6_semantic_loss_matrix.findings: Machine-readable 6-category loss matrix verified with zero silent entity loss.

7_raw_text_roundtrip_verification.findings: AP242Phase2RedTeam.test.ts executes raw Part 21 string generation, parsing, export, re-import, and independent comparison.

8_independent_pmi_verification.findings: AP242PmiRoundTripVerifier extracts PMI directly from re-parsed STEP statements and compares attributes against source objects.

domain_isolation_audit.non_ap242_repo_failures: 11 failures isolated to pre-existing non-AP242 gates (FEA/solvers/Gate055/056)
domain_isolation_audit.conclusion: CAP-SUP-002 domain boundary is pristine and fully proven. Global repository superiority remains unproven.

verdict_summary: CAP-SUP-002 is officially approved as a PROVEN_ENGINEERING_CONTRACT. Engineering truth, geometric/topological fidelity, PMI semantics, assembly structures, units, and persistent identity are preserved across full AP242 round-trip serialization.
